   - Extreme heat

     - No access to electricity

     - No access to social protection
     - No access to financial instrument

items.title: Measuring the vulnerability of people at high risk from climate-related hazards
items.content:
Flowchart diagram defining when a "Person is at risk from climate hazards if...":

- Risk requires: "Exposed to climate hazards" AND "Vulnerable to experiencing losses"

1. Exposed to climate hazards (requires Any 1):
   - Flood
   - Drought
   - Extreme heat
   - Cyclone

2. Vulnerable to experiencing losses:
   - Physically vulnerable (requires Any 1):
     - No access to water
     - No access to electricity
     - Low access to services and markets
   - Unable to cope (requires Any 1):
     - Low income
     - No access to social protection
     - No access to financial instrument
     - Low education level

Source: World Bank Group Scorecard indicator: the percentage of people at high risk of climate-related hazards globally, https://scorecard.worldbank.org/en/scorecard/home.
